name: cortex-voice
description: On-device voice capture MCP for Cortex (macOS). Records a short spoken utterance, transcribes it with Apple's Speech framework on-device, classifies it as a recall query or a memory, and returns the transcript plus a routing hint. Ears-only: it never reads or writes memories — the caller chains to the Cortex MCP recall/remember tools.

locale.title: Speech locale
locale.description: BCP-47 locale for on-device recognition (e.g. en-US, fr-FR). Must be a locale Apple Speech supports on this Mac.

default_mode.title: Default routing mode
default_mode.description: How listen routes when called without an explicit mode: 'auto' (classify recall vs remember), 'recall', or 'remember'.
